inputs.label: Cooked Super Mario Galaxy data
inputs.help: The cooked folder made on a PC from your own Super Mario Galaxy disc (European RMGP01 or US RMGE01).

preparedWith.help: Extract your Super Mario Galaxy disc with Dolphin or DolphinTool into sys and files folders. Then, from the unzipped GalaxyQuest-converter folder, run: python tools/cook/cook.py extracted cooked --with-movies

steps.text: Open GalaxyQuest from Library > Unknown Sources. On the setup screen, pick the cooked folder in Download.

notes: This follows the guide's "without adb" route: copy the cooked folder to Download and pick it in the app. tools/push_data.py instead unpacks it into Android/data/com.galaxy.quest/files/game/, which the payload checks for sys/fst.bin. Uncertain: whether the cooked folder itself contains sys/fst.bin. The Windows installer in the release does every step itself. The guide installs with adb install --no-incremental -r.
